text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — getting a spike in noisy alerts this morning around node_exporter and our GPU runtime metrics. SLO dashboard shows backend scrape_errors and scrape_duration jumping in us-east-1.
AJ: Saw it too. A bunch of nodes report scrape_duration_seconds{job=\"node_exporter\"} > 1.2s and Prometheus ingestion lag is creeping. Wondering if this is a network flap or exporter GC.
Linh Tran: Any pattern by AZ or instance type? DCGM exporter metrics look normal from quick glance, but the gpu temperature metric names differ between exporters which may be doubling series.
Samir Patel: I pulled a sample: several nodes have extra debug labels from our kubelet bootstrap (env=dev_debug). That increases cardinality a lot. We should relabel/drop those when scraping.
Jessie Morales: Agree on relabeling. Can we add a recording rule to consolidate the temp metrics while we fix exporters? Also maybe silence the noisy alerts for 2h so oncall can triage without paging.
Maria Chen: Good call. I think keep the alert for actual node down, but mute the high-cardinality/latency ones for now.
AJ: Repro steps I ran:
```
# check pods with high scrape time
kubectl -n monitoring logs -l app=prometheus --tail=200 | grep "scrape_duration_seconds"
# check node exporter pods
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide
```
Found exporter restarts on i-0a* in us-east-1b.
Linh Tran: For the metric name mismatch, DCGM uses nv_gpu_core_temp_celsius, our node_exporter custom runtime uses gpu_temp_c. We can create a recording rule:
```
- record: gpu:core_temp_celsius:avg
  expr: coalesce(nv_gpu_core_temp_celsius, gpu_temp_c)
```
That will unify dashboards quickly.
Samir Patel: For relabeling drop example (prometheus scrape_config):
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_env]
    regex: dev_debug
    action: drop
```
This will remove dev debug nodes from the problematic job.
Jessie Morales: I'll open an Alertmanager silence for 2h targeting alertnames: NodeExporterHighScrapeLatency, ExporterHighCardinality — will tag with #oncall to indicate manual triage.
oncall-bot: Silence created (id=abc123) by Jessie Morales for 2 hours — targets: NodeExporterHighScrapeLatency, ExporterHighCardinality.
AJ: Also saw kube-proxy conntrack errors around same time in the node logs: truncated network retries may explain timeouts. cc @eng-networks for follow-up.
Maria Chen: Action items: (1) Jessie create silence (done), (2) Samir add relabel PR to prometheus config and patch via kustomize, (3) Linh add recording rule for unified GPU temp and a short-term dashboard overlay, (4) AJ and eng-networks dig into conntrack/networking. I'll link runbook when created.
Samir Patel: I'll include a small note to limit scrape_interval for node_exporter to 60s instead of 15s for large node pools as temporary mitigation to reduce Prom TSDB churn and cost.
Linh Tran: One more: add a Prometheus alert tweak to require 10m of sustained high latency rather than 3m; reduces flapping. Example rule:
```
- alert: NodeExporterScrapeLatencyHigh
  expr: avg_over_time(scrape_duration_seconds{job=\"node_exporter\"}[10m]) > 0.8
  for: 15m
```
Jessie Morales: I'll file the follow-up tickets and assign owners.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene in #eng-infra tomorrow 10am to confirm fixes and lift the silence if stable. :thumbsup:
